# Poly Haven assets (CC0 1.0)

All assets in this folder are from Poly Haven (https://polyhaven.com) and are released under CC0 1.0 Universal (public domain, no attribution required). Downloaded 2026-10-12 via the public API (https://api.polyhaven.com). FBX 2K variants with their referenced textures, plus JPG 2K/4K maps.

Generated locally (derived, also CC0): `*_hdrpmask_*.png` = HDRP mask maps built from Poly Haven ARM maps (R metal, G AO, A 1-roughness); `*_diffalpha_2k.png` = diffuse with the alpha map packed in for alpha clipping.
